Forsyth Election Season 2026
Date
Deadline or event

30-day residency deadline for the General Election.

Voter registration deadline for the General Election. Forms must be postmarked or delivered in person by 5 PM. Deadline for voters to change party affiliation.

First day of early voting. Voting begins at 8 AM.

Last day to request an absentee by-mail ballot by 5 PM for General Election

Last day of early voting ends at 3 PM

Election Day — General Election.
Polls open at 6:30 AM and close at 7:30 PM; Deadline for all absentee by-mail ballots to be returned by 7:30 PM

Election Schedule
Primary and General Elections
In North Carolina, you may only vote in the primary election of the party with which you are affiliated/registered. If you register as unaffiliated, you may be allowed to vote in a primary election if a party allows unaffiliated voters to vote in their primary election. In primary elections you NOMINATE party candidates and in general elections you ELECT officials.

Board of Education District 1 (2 seats, 4 year terms)

Board of Education At Large (3 seats, 4 year terms)

Town of Rural Hall - Mayor (3 year term in 2023, 4 year term starting 2026) and Council Members (4 seats, 3 year terms in 2023 & 2025, 4 year terms starting 2026 & 2028) Session Law 2023-31
